verdict: Leads are arriving efficiently; the gap is getting them into your pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 176 leads from Meta at a cost of $12 per lead — your most efficient cost per lead on record for this account, which previously ran between $19 and $45. Lead volume also ticked up 2.33% and cost per lead dropped 5.24% week over week, pointing to a campaign that is maturing well. The immediate concern is that 40 of those leads do not appear in your CRM, and zero leads have been moved into an active pipeline opportunity this period — meaning leads are arriving but not being worked as cases. We are addressing the intake process directly so that every lead from Meta is captured and queued for follow-up.
